Choosing between the AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 has traditionally come down to fit, features, and price. Apple has been developing AirPods with cameras that add Visual Intelligence, but they aren't expected to launch until 2027 at the earliest. That means a potentially long wait.

AirPods 4 balance comfort and value with multiple options

The AirPods 4 feature an open design and are worth considering if you dislike silicone ear tips. According to our AirPods 4 review, the redesigned shape fits comfortably without sacrificing convenience in daily use.

The $129 model is equipped with the Apple H2 chip and Personalized Spatial Audio, offering up to five hours of listening time. However, it lacks Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, and wireless charging.

The $179 model adds useful Active Noise Cancellation without sealing the ear canal, along with Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

The open design still lets in more ambient noise, so noise cancellation will be less effective on planes and public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 offer the most complete feature set

The AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249 on Apple's official store, though Amazon frequently offers discounts. They come with memory foam ear tips, delivering stronger bass and improved noise cancellation. According to Apple, battery life reaches up to eight hours with ANC enabled, compared to just four hours for the AirPods 4 with ANC.

They can measure heart rate during workouts and support Apple's hearing test, hearing aid, and hearing protection features. According to our AirPods Pro 3 review, heart rate readings during exercise are largely consistent with Apple Watch data.

On the other hand, iOS 27 adds a custom EQ feature for both models, while the AirPods Pro 3 enjoy an extra edge thanks to the heart rate sensor and a newer charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, information about AirPods with Visual Intelligence leaked from a video hidden within the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate. It appears to show someone using Siri to remember a book via Visual Intelligence on camera-equipped AirPods, leading to speculation that a launch could be imminent.

However, subsequent reports told a different story. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that camera-equipped AirPods are still scheduled for a 2027 launch. The B798 model appearing in the video is reportedly a revised design of the AirPods Pro 3 that has recently been removed from Apple's 2026 roadmap. Apple continues to develop the next-generation B798 version.

Which AirPods should you buy?

If price is your top priority and you don't need noise cancellation, go with the $129 AirPods 4. If you prefer the open-fit feel, go with the AirPods 4 with ANC.

For everyone else, the AirPods Pro 3 remain the most worthwhile choice, especially when Amazon drops them close to the price of the AirPods 4 with ANC. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, heart rate monitoring, and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods prices

  • AirPods 4 ($99, originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC ($148.99, originally $179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, originally $249)

Unless Visual Intelligence is critically important to you, waiting isn't a wise move. Those who need new earphones shouldn't forgo stronger ANC, longer battery life, and other practical benefits for over a year just to wait for an unannounced feature.

Otherwise, choose based on what you need today. Currently discounted AirPods already meet the practical needs of most buyers, while the future camera-equipped version may be priced higher or sell near full price during its initial months of availability.

Make the most of your Apple products
